sources.entry: Privoxy - Non-caching web proxy with advanced filtering capabilities for enhancing privacy, modifying web page data and HTTP headers, controlling access, and removing ads and other obnoxious Internet junk. GPL-2.0 C/deb

summary.name: Privoxy
summary.one_liner: Privoxy is a free, non-caching web proxy that filters web traffic to enhance privacy, modify page data and HTTP headers, control access, and remove ads.
use_cases: Blocking ads and web junk across a network
Enhancing browsing privacy by filtering requests
Controlling web access for users on a multi-user network
Customizing web page content on a stand-alone system
summary.what_it_does: Privoxy sits as a non-caching web proxy and applies advanced filtering to web traffic. It can modify web page data and HTTP headers, control access, and remove ads and other unwanted content. Its configuration is flexible and can be tailored to individual needs, and it can be used on a stand-alone system or on a multi-user network. The page states the latest release is 4.2.0 (stable) and that downloads are available from the project site and a mirror.
notable: Non-caching proxy with flexible, customizable filtering configuration
Free Software licensed under GNU GPLv2 or later
Associated project of Software in the Public Interest (SPI)
Website also available as a Tor onion service
caveats: Page states the project has no trusted build infrastructure; binary packages are built by individual members or external contributors, so users should check signatures
